purpose: Explicit build-resource profiles. A profile changes compiler resources only; it never turns a failed build into PASS.

conservative.description: Lowest memory pressure; slowest diagnostic fallback.

balanced.description: Default milestone/release profile after route-graph reduction.

throughput.description: Use only on a measured high-memory runner.

requiredComparison: Run one sharded/static graph profile first.
Run Webpack and Turbopack once per release candidate using the same source SHA.
If balanced fails from memory, retry conservative; do not repeatedly rerun unchanged builds.
